name: Projected Recursive Teaching Dimension of the Three-Code Class
proof: The full class has recursive teaching dimension one. Each proper coordinate projection is either a singleton/two-concept class or a three-trace path, and its endpoints give a recursive teaching batch of size one. Thus every projection has RTD at most one, and the maximum is one. All projections are enumerated in $\texttt{sync/verify\_properness\_separation.py}$.
references: Direct calculation from the class definition; compare the projected variant in \cite{doliwa2014recursive}.
